title: Start gauge (GAS)
description: Gauge auto shift starts here and drops to the next gauge when this one fails.

title: Bottom gauge (GAS)
description: Lowest gauge GAS can fall back to.

title: TOTAL formula
description: standard: 7.605N/(0.01N+6.5). lr2: 160+(N+clamp(N-400,0,200))*0.16. beatoraja: max(260, standard). custom: the value below.

title: Custom TOTAL
description: Used when the TOTAL formula is custom.

title: Count empty POOR
description: Key presses that don't land on a note. Works with tosu alone up to 4K; 5K and above need the lr2hp-for-osu app (lr2hp-for-osu.exe) running.

title: Empty POOR mode
description: lr2oraja: only presses up to 1 s before the lane's next note (LR2's rule). near: next note within 500 ms. all: every stray press during the chart.

title: Early-press MISS counts as BAD
description: osu! gives a MISS for a press 127-164 ms early (OD8); LR2 would call it a BAD. On: that POOR becomes a BAD.

title: Input offset (ms)
description: Usually leave at 0: the song clock calibrates itself from osu!'s hit offsets.

title: Show press stats
description: Debug readout: presses confirmed as hits, early misses, empty POORs and the clock correction.

title: Key layout source
description: sync: osu!'s own mania key bindings, read by the lr2hp-for-osu app (lr2hp-for-osu.exe) from lazer and stable; key counts it has none for use the layouts below. manual: always the layouts below.

title: 4K keys
description: Space-separated, left to right. Letters, digits, Space, LShift, RShift, ; , . / [ ] etc.

title: 6K keys
value: S D F J K L

title: 7K keys
value: S D F Space J K L

title: 8K keys
value: A S D F J K L ;

title: 9K keys
value: A S D F Space J K L ;

title: 10K keys
value: A S D F V N J K L ;

title: Skin
description: flat: simple-play's flat gauge. classic: simple-play's original default gauge, glossy red / cyan bars.

title: Segments
description: LR2 uses 50 (2% each); the simple-play skin uses 60.

title: Gauge length (px)
description: Length of the bar, not counting the number. 0 = the skin's own segment width (12 px per segment).

title: Show all four gauges
description: Small readout of every gauge running in the background.

title: Show empty POOR status
description: Shows a note when empty POOR can't be detected.
